# Markov Chains

A Markov chain describes transitions between states with probabilities that depend only on the current state.

$$
P(X_{n+1}=j \mid X_n=i) = P_{ij}
$$

For a 2-state chain,

$$
P = \begin{pmatrix}
1-\alpha & \alpha \\
\beta & 1-\beta
\end{pmatrix}
$$

The long-time behavior of the chain depends on the structure of this matrix, especially the stationary distribution and mixing properties.
